question: What effect does daily non-eating have on age and death?
premises: Age and death are named together
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will overcome age and death.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ may mean going beyond or reaching the end of age and death
plain_english: By fasting day by day, one will indeed overcome age and death.
